children: UAE-based Azizi Developments, a leading private developer in the UAE, continues to accelerate its delivery momentum across its wider portfolio. The developer has handed over seven projects during 2026 to date and aims to hand over an additional 10 projects between now and December 2026. Azizi currently has more than 150,000 units under construction at various stages, reflecting the scale and pace of its ongoing development pipeline.

One of the communities Azizi will continue to deliver moving forward is Azizi Venice, a large scale waterfront destination in Dubai South, where momentum continues to build as the community advances through its sales and construction phase.

Group CEO Farhad Azizi said: “The pace of handovers across our portfolio this year reflects the discipline, precision and focus on quality that guide every stage of our construction and handover process. With further projects scheduled for delivery in the months ahead, we remain firmly focused on maintaining this momentum across our portfolio, while delivering the quality and lifestyle our residents and investors expect from us.”
Azizi Venice is a Venice inspired waterfront community in Dubai South, built around an 18-km-long swimmable lagoon and anchored by a 700-m retail boulevard.

Positioned close to Al Maktoum International Airport, the community brings together residential, retail and leisure destinations, with construction continuing across its phases ahead of handovers scheduled through 2026 and into 2027.

Azizi Developments has delivered more than 45,000 homes to investors and end-users of over 100 nationalities since its founding and continues to expand its footprint with new communities across the UAE.

title: ZAWYA: UAE: Azizi set to deliver 10 more projects by year-end
